paper_title: TL;DR Too Long, Do Re-weighting for Effcient LLM Reasoning Compression
caption: Comparison of accuracy and generation length between Vanilla CoT and our method on four benchmark datasets (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, AMC) using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. consistently reduces generation length while maintaining or improving accuracy across both 7B and 14B model scales.

model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates a comparison of generation length, measured in words, between “Vanilla CoT” and “TLDR (Ours)” across four datasets: GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC. The horizontal axis displays the dataset names in the order GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, while the vertical axis represents generation length, labeled as “Generation Length (words)”. The vertical axis has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8000, with tick marks every 1000 words. Each dataset contains two bars representing the generation length for “Vanilla CoT” in light red and “TLDR (Ours)” in dark red. For GSM8K, “Vanilla CoT” has a generation length of approximately 554 words and “TLDR (Ours)” has a generation length of 2861 words.  For MATH500, “Vanilla CoT” reaches around 4510 words, and “TLDR (Ours)” is approximately 2861 words, as well. The AIME dataset shows “Vanilla CoT” at 6820 words and “TLDR (Ours)” at approximately 4510 words, and the AMC dataset contains “Vanilla CoT” at approximately 2861 words and “TLDR (Ours)” at 554 words.  Percentage difference labels are included above each bar pair, indicating the change in generation length between the two methods for each dataset. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order, and none are visibly emphasized through shading or outlining.
model_annotations.German: This bar chart illustrates the generation length in words of two methods, Vanilla CoT and TLDR (Ours), across four benchmark datasets: GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. The horizontal axis represents the dataset names, listed in the order GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC. The vertical axis, labeled “Generation Length (words),” displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8000, with tick marks every 1000 units. For each dataset, two bars are presented side-by-side: a light red bar representing Vanilla CoT and a dark red bar representing TLDR (Ours).  For GSM8K, the Vanilla CoT bar reaches a height of 554 words while the TLDR bar reaches 2861 words; for MATH500, the heights are 4510 and 2861 words respectively; for AIME, the values are 6820 and 4510 words; and for AMC, the values are approximately 7200 and 5500 words. Percentage changes are annotated above the Vanilla CoT bars for each dataset: -54%, -46%, -7%, and -25%. The bars are not sorted in any discernible order, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or outlining.
